required_input_state.restoration_rule: Restore exact requested identities and actions, including responsive-binding scope/effects/exclusions and approval gate references when present. Recheck current availability, freshness, completeness, compatibility, source rights, permission, approval validity, and satisfaction before repeating a request or resuming the controlled action.

test_evidence_state.restoration_rule: Restore evidence references, reproducibility state, regulatory obligations, and presentation preference as separate state. Presentation mode never proves evidence exists and never changes evidence obligations. Revalidate referenced suites, manifests, results, logs, fixtures, sanitization state, current inputs/environment/permissions, and exact run identities. Missing records remain missing; do not fabricate them from a smaller prior display.

grounding_state.restoration_rule: Revalidate exact component and manifest identities, dependency compatibility, task fit, approval state, and current Orbit 0 compilation before treating Grounding support as operative.

ai_governance_state.restoration_rule: Revalidate exact package and component identities, current source authority and freshness, source rights, jurisdiction, organizational role, lifecycle, intended purpose, regulatory evidence obligations, framework-adapter availability, task fit, approval state, and Orbit 0 compilation. Do not treat prior analysis or validation as legal advice, compliance proof, certification, conformity, deployment approval, or current-source verification.

cognitive_scope_state.restoration_rule: Restore declared scope identity and contribution references only as non-authorizing continuation input. Revalidate current task/Artifact scope, inputs, protected control state, contribution availability, and validation-ingress eligibility before operative reuse; never reconstruct hidden reasoning or infer prior control authority from a contribution.

continuation_bootstrap.material_execution_resume_condition: A current HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment evaluation succeeds and exactly one validated artifact is rebound to Orbit 0 with ACTIVE_EXECUTION_BINDING.
continuation_bootstrap.missing_active_candidate_behavior: Compile a new candidate from restored project state and current user direction.
continuation_bootstrap.user_task_change_behavior: Treat selection as bootstrap input; promote selected task and queue the prior nomination if still valid.
continuation_bootstrap.required_input_recheck: Before repeating a request or resuming its controlled action, recheck session availability, validated package state, freshness, completeness, compatibility, source rights, permission, and satisfaction. Preserve exact identities and do not infer satisfaction from attachment alone.
continuation_bootstrap.test_evidence_recheck: Restore test_evidence_state without treating the card or presentation mode as proof that tests ran or evidence is sufficient. Revalidate every referenced suite, manifest, result, log, fixture, sanitization state, reproducibility claim, and regulatory obligation. If requested evidence was never captured, preserve the gap and require a new authorized run when that evidence is material.
continuation_bootstrap.method_handoff_recheck: When method continuation is material, validate method identity/version/origin, active method state/step/gate, staleness, evidence references, blockers, next action, method_specific_state against the current method requirements, and every preserved AIR_METHOD_EVIDENCE_WAIVER ref against its exact current method/version/step/requirement/artifact scope. Missing material state or invalid waiver refs route to REVIEW; do not invent them.
continuation_bootstrap.responsive_binding_recheck: Restore responsive-binding requests and approval evidence only as continuation input. Revalidate the exact approval gate, disclosed scope/effects, component identity, freshness, compatibility, selection, and artifact compilation before binding. Attachment history alone is not approval.
continuation_bootstrap.specialist_catalog_recheck: When specialist catalog provenance is recorded, compare the originating AIR_SPECIALIST_PACKAGE_INDEX identity with any currently supplied validated index before using the current index for new discovery. Exact same-release catalog identity permits normal discovery after explicit handoff Specialist/package state is restored and revalidated. A missing index degrades discovery without invalidating otherwise valid explicit handoff state. A different or foundation-incompatible index is a new-environment discovery input and requires targeted compatibility reconciliation before new catalog discovery. Never substitute, select, approve, bind, or rewrite restored Specialist state from index metadata alone.
continuation_bootstrap.runtime_alignment_recheck: Historical alignment evaluation identities and results are provenance only. Execute a new Core RT.ALIGN evaluation using HANDOFF_RESTORE profile against current-session state before any restored state becomes execution-bearing.
continuation_bootstrap.semantic_fidelity_recheck: Restore only explicit canonical-intent/context references and unresolved semantic ambiguities, then reconcile them against available raw input/source evidence and current user direction. Do not silently reinterpret missing intent.
continuation_bootstrap.mii_recheck: Restore MII contribution references, conflict state, and morphology state as non-authorizing continuation input. Revalidate contribution availability/task fit and compile applicable validated contributions into or explicitly reference them from the rebound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark before operative use.
continuation_bootstrap.route_map_recheck: AIR_RUNTIME_ROUTE_MAP.json is discovery/salience metadata only. If supplied, validate identity and Core compatibility; if missing or stale, Core route semantics remain authoritative and runtime continues without granting the map semantic authority. When target readiness is material, revalidate the completion envelope and any serialized step-optimality basis before treating stage completion or promotion as current.
continuation_bootstrap.handoff_mode_recheck: Restore handoff_mode_state as non-authorizing continuation input. Revalidate mode/schema integrity and current-session state; neither strict nor portable source mode grants execution authority.
continuation_bootstrap.fresh_project_isolation_rule: A Handoff continuation card is continuation input only. For a distinct fresh-project bootstrap reset continuation Orbit/task state, artifact lease, approval state, task binding, Specialist selection, and Specialist binding. Acceptance/test/prior-project state remains provenance only and grants zero execution authority.
continuation_bootstrap.specialist_lifecycle_recheck: Preserve DISCOVERED/AVAILABLE/VALIDATED/LOADED/SELECTED/APPROVED_IF_REQUIRED/BOUND distinctions and evidence. Handoff state outranks catalog discovery metadata for restoration identity, but all current-session validation/approval/binding requirements still apply.
continuation_bootstrap.response_transaction_recheck: Restore only ACTIVE/RESUMABLE response_transaction_state. Closed/aborted/expired transactions retire to history. Revalidate transaction/checkpoint identity, allowed-effect boundary, next transition, expiry, and current dependencies; transfer state grants no execution authority.
continuation_bootstrap.execution_steering_recheck: For executable continuation, require active Artifact payload or resolvable Artifact ref carrying Core-owned execution_steering. Reconstructed candidates remain UNBOUND_DRAFT with NOT_ISSUED_PREBIND lease, null resource pin, empty valid action classes, and zero authority until atomic current-session binding.
continuation_bootstrap.public_release_recheck: When public_release_state is present, revalidate release identity, manifests/pins/hashes, reproducibility, generated provenance, signing/authenticity/external verification, supply chain/security, migration/compatibility, rollback/recovery, upgrade, docs/release notes, and claim/evidence state. Final AMRS-6 promotion and publication remain separate explicit human approvals.
continuation_bootstrap.validation_architecture_recheck: Revalidate every PASS evidence basis against exact source revision/hash/dependency closure. Basis-invalidated PASS becomes STALE_PENDING_REVALIDATION and cannot support current Gate, maturity, release, or closure.
continuation_bootstrap.runtime_identity_recheck: Revalidate explicit system_identity/runtime_generation. AIR-P may not silently fall back or substitute legacy/direct AIR; any compatibility mode must be explicit.
continuation_bootstrap.project_target_readiness_recheck: Restore explicit Q5-R or exact Q5 target reuse only; preserve NOT_APPLICABLE/UNRESOLVED and never silently default the project target to AMRS-6.
continuation_bootstrap.approval_scope_recheck: Restore scope identity, fingerprint, token pair, source approval state, and gate context only as non-authorizing continuation data. Discard current exact-token-match provenance and current render completion. Set restored open scope token rendering to RENDER_REQUIRED_AFTER_RESTORE and require both exact current tokens to be visibly re-rendered before approval resolution is eligible. No prior approval, role assignment, Q6 wording, handoff state, Gate, or Authorization becomes current execution authority.
continuation_bootstrap.law_resolution_recheck: Restore law-resolution contract identity/version, registry/router identity/fingerprints, task identity/AMRS/classes/facets, selected laws, floor/law-dependency/runtime-dependency closure, applicability evidence and source fingerprint only as non-authorizing continuation input. For AIR_LAW_RESOLUTION_CONSTRUCTION_V1@1.0.0, set restored current resolution STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_RERESOLUTION, execute fresh current-session resolution, recompute AIR_LAW_RESOLUTION_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 bytes and SHA-256 fingerprint, and compare only within the same exact contract version and semantic inputs. A non-null legacy fingerprint without an explicit compatible resolution contract version is LEGACY_UNVERIFIABLE and cannot be interpreted as V1. Changed or unresolved basis remains stale/unresolved with law_resolution_fingerprint=null before Artifact rebinding.
continuation_bootstrap.onboarding_semantics_recheck: Q2 remains review-intensity-only and cannot create scope/approval/AMRS/floor authority. For pre-rev21 Q3 state, preserve the old A/B/C value as q3_legacy_ambiguity_posture with LEGACY_AMBIGUITY_POSTURE_V1 semantics; do not reinterpret it as blocker disposition. Resolve current BLOCKER_DISPOSITION_V2 Q3 explicitly when material.
continuation_bootstrap.deferred_blocker_backlog_recheck: Restore deferred non-mandatory blocker backlog items as non-authorizing continuation state. Reclassify mandatory versus non-mandatory before continuing; mandatory blockers cannot be converted into deferred backlog items.
continuation_bootstrap.air_repair_recheck: Restore repair/check/align/fix state as non-authorizing evidence and routing state only. Revalidate defect class, repairability, affected state, material-action approval requirements, post-repair verification, and failure-mode constraints before any repair continuation.
continuation_bootstrap.state_epoch_provenance_recheck: Restore state-epoch provenance as historical transfer state only. Recompute current RESPONSE_EMISSION_CLOSURE; validate optional omission records against their source_state_epoch; required-object omission remains fail-closed.
continuation_bootstrap.checkpoint_lineage_recheck: Restore self-contained checkpoint lineage only from exact carried records/durable canonical refs. Revalidate Artifact/source/dependency/approval/package identities, active constraints, completed receipts, blockers, next transition, invalidators and evidence; conversation prose supplies no missing authority.
continuation_bootstrap.durable_dependency_recheck: Restore AIR_DEPENDENCY_RECORD carriers as non-authorizing state and revalidate required/observed identities, satisfaction/blocking state, evidence, invalidation and resume conditions. Prose blockers cannot substitute for a required durable dependency record.
continuation_bootstrap.model_drift_migration_recheck: Preserve pre-rev24 historical alignment snapshots exactly. Never rewrite legacy broad-drift evidence. Recompute current model drift under the current AIR_ALIGNMENT_CHECK boolean/truth-table contract and route ordinary non-model mismatch to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
continuation_bootstrap.decision_trace_recheck: Revalidate transferred Decision Trace state against exact current evidence/rule identities, current law_resolution_fingerprint, controlling Artifact revision/lease, authority state, uncertainty and forced-walk basis. A transferred CURRENT trace is non-authorizing and restores as STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_REVALIDATION until this recheck passes. Never synthesize missing historical traces or infer NONE_REQUIRED when trace requirement is materially unresolved.

rules.v2_2_to_v2_3_alignment: MIGRATE runtime_watchdog_state/cadence carriers as historical provenance only. Preserve post_activation_user_message_count only as diagnostic/anchor state. Do not restore alignment intervals, periodic-due state, or historical PASS as current authority. Execute a new HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment evaluation.
rules.v2_2_to_v2_3_evidence_presentation: Map legacy SUMMARY_ONLY display intent to STANDARD_EVIDENCE_PRESENTATION and legacy FULL_TEST_EVIDENCE display intent to EXPANDED_EVIDENCE_PRESENTATION only. Do not infer evidence capture or reproducibility from the old display mode.
rules.v2_2_to_v2_3_mii: Missing MII, semantic-fidelity, morphology, or epistemic-sufficiency carriers are valid legacy absence, not inferred completed state. Reconstruct only from explicit supported source/artifact state and current evaluation; otherwise preserve UNRESOLVED or request required input.
rules.v2_3_rev14_to_rev15_target_readiness: Rev14 cards remain valid schema-2.3.0 migration input. Reconstruct target readiness and step-optimality state only from explicit completion definition, acceptance criteria, readiness, benchmark, evidence, and blocker state. If not fully recoverable, preserve TARGET_UNRESOLVED / NOT_EVALUATED and route to current uncertainty or review; do not invent PASS.
rules.v2_3_rev16_to_rev17_patch_and_approval_i: Rev16 cards remain valid schema-2.3.0 migration input. Add patch-reconciliation carriers with unresolved safe defaults. Do not infer a missing approval fingerprint; a non-null open approval scope requires exact recomputation from complete explicit fields plus scope-id history validation or routes to REVIEW/reacquisition.
rules.v2_3_rev17_to_rev18_cognitive_scope_auth: Rev17 cards remain valid schema-2.3.0 migration input. Add the cognitive-scope carrier with non-authorizing unresolved defaults and a stable MII reference. Preserve explicit supported contribution references only; do not reconstruct hidden reasoning, validated ingestion, or control authority. Require current HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment and Artifact rebinding.
rules.legacy_2_2_floor_revision_semantics: SUPPORTED_2_2_FLOOR_PROFILE: legacy card_revision is user_revision; template revision is UNRECORDED_LEGACY_PROFILE and is never inferred from the numeric user counter.
rules.legacy_2_3_pre_rev19_revision_semantics: SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_2_3_PRE_REV19: legacy card_revision is template revision only after schema 2.3.0 is established; user revision remains UNRECORDED unless independently explicit.
rules.rev19_revision_split: CURRENT_REV19_PLUS: template_revision selects format migration; user_revision counts successful Handoff generations in the lineage and has zero format authority.
rules.v2_3_rev19_to_rev20_handoff_mode: Rev19 cards remain valid schema-2.3.0 migration input. Preserve split revision lineage and explicit provenance state; add handoff_mode_state as non-authorizing NOT_EVALUATED input; do not infer historical mode selection.
rules.rev20_handoff_mode: CURRENT_REV20_PLUS: template_revision selects format migration; handoff_mode_state declares strict/portable request and selected assurance semantics; user_revision remains format-nonauthoritative.
rules.v2_3_rev22_to_rev23_law_resolution_const: Rev22 cards remain schema-2.3.0 migration input. Add AIR_LAW_RESOLUTION_CONSTRUCTION_V1@1.0.0 carriers, law_dependency_ids, task_class_ids, task_facet_ids and applicability_evidence with non-authorizing defaults. Preserve a rev22 non-null unversioned law_resolution_fingerprint only as LEGACY_UNVERIFIABLE historical provenance; never interpret it as V1. Set current resolution STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_RERESOLUTION and require fresh current-session V1 recomputation before Artifact rebinding.
rules.v2_3_rev23_to_rev24_model_drift_checkpoi: Rev23 cards remain schema-2.3.0 migration input. Preserve every historical alignment snapshot exactly and classify pre-rev24 broad-drift interpretation as legacy/non-authorizing. Add state_epoch_provenance_state, checkpoint_lineage_state, durable_dependency_state, and complete artifact-lease provenance fields with safe non-authorizing defaults when missing. Recompute current model drift during HANDOFF_RESTORE; ordinary non-model mismatch routes to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED. Never synthesize missing checkpoint/dependency/provenance history or authority.
rules.v2_3_rev24_to_rev25_decision_trace: Rev24 cards remain schema-2.3.0 migration input. Add required decision_trace_state with empty non-authorizing UNVALIDATED_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT defaults plus semantic_fidelity_state.decision_trace_refs=[] and decision_trace_transfer_state=UNVALIDATED_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT. Never synthesize historical traces. Any transferred CURRENT Decision Trace becomes STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_REVALIDATION until exact current evidence/rules/Artifact/authority/uncertainty/forced-walk basis is revalidated. Historical traces remain immutable nonoperative provenance. If the declared next material step depends on a current trace, the migrated/restored card must carry its exact projection/fingerprint or a blocking required-input identity.

operator_semantics.APPROVAL_SCOPE_CANONICAL_TOKEN_PAIR: For non-null material open scope, require approval_response_mode=EXACT_CANONICAL_SCOPE_TOKEN_PAIR and operational_response_tokens set equality with exactly AIR_APPROVE::<approval_scope_id> and AIR_REJECT::<approval_scope_id>. operator_semantics.OBJECT_VISIBILITY_AUTHORITY_VALID: visibility_mode_ref must name AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.object_visibility_mode. MINIMUM_REQUIRED_OBJECTS requires USER_EXPLICIT or RESTORED_EXPLICIT_SELECTION and non-null selection_evidence_ref; LEGACY_UNVERIFIED_SELECTION cannot restore minimum and clamps to ALL_OBJECTS.
operator_semantics.PROFILE_POSTURE_ACCEPTANCE_VALID: Each accepted weaker posture requires exact profile/delta identity, USER_EXPLICIT acceptance evidence, scope and lifecycle. Missing, legacy-unrecorded, or conflicting acceptance clamps to Default Starter baseline.
operator_semantics.ACTIVE_METHOD_PACK_HANDOFF_SCHEMA_VALID: If method_origin=METHOD_PACK, schema ref/version must exactly match the active Method Pack handoff_requirements.method_specific_state_schema and method_specific_state must satisfy required fields. Missing schema or field routes REVIEW without reconstruction.
operator_semantics.SOURCE_RIGHTS_PROJECTION_CONSISTENT: Governance-owned source_rights_id is canonical. Generic projections must reference that owner, set authoritative=false, and match projected_rights_state; conflicts route REVIEW.
operator_semantics.PATCH_ACTIVITY_REQUIREMENTS_VALID: ACTIVE_FILE_MUTATION_OR_PATCH requires nonempty source_inventory, replacement_policy, mutation_scope, validation_plan and last_validation_state carrier. When repository patch reconciliation is material, repository_source_ref/source_commit/source_tree, tracked_file_count, reconciled_file_count, unclassified_file_count, reconciliation_state, disposition_matrix_ref, and post-patch reconciliation state must be present; completion requires tracked_file_count=reconciled_file_count, unclassified_file_count=0, reconciliation_state=PASS, and required post-patch reconciliation=PASS.
operator_semantics.AMRS_STEP_OPTIMALITY_COMPLETION_VALID: When the completion trigger is true, path_validation_state must be COMPLETE_FOR_ACTIVE_STEP and step_optimality_state must be PASS with preserved basis/stopping evidence as applicable.
operator_semantics.METHOD_EVIDENCE_WAIVER_REFS_VALID: If active Method Pack method_specific_state declares step_evidence_waiver_refs, each non-null ref must resolve to a surfaced canonical AIR_METHOD_EVIDENCE_WAIVER snapshot whose method/version/step/waived_requirement/artifact scope match the serialized method state and whose validity_state is ACTIVE_CURRENT or APPLIED_RECORDED. Empty refs are allowed when no waiver was used. Unresolved, free-text, mismatched, revoked, expired, or synthesized refs route REVIEW.
operator_semantics.APPROVAL_SCOPE_IDENTITY_FINGERPRINT_VALI: For a non-null material open scope, recompute SHA-256 canonical JSON over the Core-owned fingerprint field set; require equality with approval_scope_fingerprint; require the approval_scope_id not be associated with a different prior lifecycle fingerprint; revision suffixes are optional. Produce OPEN_APPROVAL_SCOPE_IDENTITY_VALIDATION_STATE=VALIDATED_CURRENT_UNIQUE_SCOPE_FINGERPRINT only on success.
operator_semantics.HANDOFF_MODE_PROVENANCE_VALID: Validate AIR_HANDOFF_MODE_SELECTION_V1 deterministically. STRICT_PROVENANCE requires AVAILABLE_VERIFIED durability, ELIGIBLE strict state, complete ledger-backed snapshots and ledger-backed failure history. PORTABLE_STATE requires no FAILED_INTEGRITY, no complete-history claim, empty surfaced-object snapshot entries, empty failure-mode records, no reconstructed historical action authority, and positive_execution_authority = NONE. Explicit strict never downgrades.
operator_semantics.HANDOFF_GENERATION_EVALUATION_VALID: Require AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.evaluation_basis to be the sole root generation-evaluation carrier and to identify the current HANDOFF_CREATE evaluation with current state_epoch, alignment_check_ref, validation_report_ref, and dependency_state=SATISFIED. Reject missing, template, stale, prior-session, non-HANDOFF_CREATE, or duplicate-root generation evaluation.
operator_semantics.PORTABLE_HANDOFF_STATE_VALID: If selected_mode is not PORTABLE_STATE, return NOT_APPLICABLE_PASS. If PORTABLE_STATE, require live durability projection not FAILED_INTEGRITY, empty surfaced_object_ledger_state.entries, completeness_state=NOT_CLAIMED_PORTABLE_STATE, empty failure_mode_state.records, history_completeness_state=NOT_CLAIMED_PORTABLE_STATE, no reconstructed historical action authority, positive_execution_authority=NONE, and valid current generation evaluation.
operator_semantics.APPROVAL_GATE_CONTEXT_REFERENCE_VALID: For non-null open approval scope, gate_context must be ACTIVE_ARTIFACT_ACTION or CANDIDATE_BINDING_TRANSITION. ACTIVE requires active_artifact_ref and forbids candidate_artifact_ref; CANDIDATE requires candidate_artifact_ref and forbids active_artifact_ref. Preserved approval/gate context is non-authorizing and must be revalidated in the current session.
operator_semantics.FOUNDATION_2_7_TRANSFER_STATE_VALID: Validate runtime identity/generation separation, Q5-R non-inference, resumable transaction lifecycle, executable steering preservation, NOT_ISSUED_PREBIND restoration, Specialist lifecycle separation, public-release human approval separation, runtime compatibility decision, and validation architecture basis binding without granting authority.
operator_semantics.STALE_EVIDENCE_REUSE_PROHIBITED: Any prior PASS whose exact source revision/hash/dependency closure no longer matches becomes STALE_PENDING_REVALIDATION and must not satisfy current Gate, maturity, release, or closure.
operator_semantics.APPROVAL_RESTORE_NONAUTHORITY_VALID: For non-null open approval scope, require token_pair_render_state_at_source to be preserved as source provenance only; require restoration_token_pair_render_state=RENDER_REQUIRED_AFTER_RESTORE, restoration_approval_authority=NONE, and exact_token_match_provenance_restoration_state=NOT_RESTORED_REQUIRES_CURRENT_EXACT_MATCH. Prior approval/Gate/Authorization or role/Q6 state cannot satisfy current approval.
operator_semantics.LAW_RESOLUTION_TRANSFER_STATE_VALID: For AIR_LAW_RESOLUTION_CONSTRUCTION_V1@1.0.0, require exact registry/router identity and fingerprints, task identity, task-target AMRS, canonical task-class/facet arrays, selected law IDs, floor/law-dependency/runtime-dependency closure, deterministic applicability evidence, resolution_state/fingerprint invariant, positive_execution_authority=NONE, and restoration_state STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_RERESOLUTION until current-session revalidation reproduces the exact V1 fingerprint. A non-null fingerprint with absent/unrecognized contract version is LEGACY_UNVERIFIABLE and grants no current resolution identity or authority.
operator_semantics.ONBOARDING_SEMANTICS_V2_TRANSFER_VALID: Q2 semantics version REVIEW_INTENSITY_V2 may influence review intensity only and has no scope/approval/AMRS/floor authority. Q3 semantics version BLOCKER_DISPOSITION_V2 is distinct from legacy ambiguity posture. Pre-rev21 Q3 values migrate to q3_legacy_ambiguity_posture and cannot populate current Q3 without explicit compatible source.
operator_semantics.FIDELITY_TRANSFER_STATE_VALID: Preserve explicit typed canonical-intent state, intent-execution alignment state, source-intent invariant refs, material-claim provenance refs, forced-walk/fidelity-audit state, current-state coherence state, claim/source consistency state, next-step evidence-closure state, restoration source reconciliation state, and omission/invention/contradiction test state without synthesizing missing provenance or intent. Current-session reconciliation is required before affected approval/execution/delivery.
operator_semantics.DEFERRED_BLOCKER_BACKLOG_VALID: Every deferred backlog item must be explicitly non-mandatory, retain identity/classification/defer basis/owner/resume condition/evidence/lifecycle, and restore with zero positive execution authority. Mandatory blockers cannot appear as deferred items.
operator_semantics.AIR_REPAIR_TRANSFER_STATE_VALID: Repair/check/align/fix transfer state is non-authorizing. Active repair state must preserve command class, defect class, repairability, affected state, evidence, post-repair verification refs, failure-mode refs, and revalidate material-action approval/Gate requirements before continuation.
operator_semantics.INTENT_EXECUTION_ALIGNMENT_TRANSFER_VALI: Require canonical_intent_state and intent_execution_alignment_state when template_revision>=22; preserve source traceability and proportionality; PASS cannot coexist with unresolved material deltas or ambiguity at the affected boundary; REVIEW/REJECT/UNRESOLVED grant zero positive authority; no claim of hidden/latent model-state inspection is permitted.
operator_semantics.CURRENT_STATE_COHERENCE_VALID: All fields represented as CURRENT/ACTIVE must reconcile with canonical transfer carriers or be explicitly typed as historical/source-snapshot/nonoperative. A completed effect cannot simultaneously remain an operative pending/not-started blocker for the same effect unless an explicit supersession/history relation explains the difference. Contradictions are never resolved by recency or convenience.
operator_semantics.CLAIM_SOURCE_CONSISTENCY_VALID: Each material claim with source_refs must be compatible with the exact referenced source identity/hash/state. A contradictory claim fails validation; unavailable source evidence yields UNKNOWN/REVIEW rather than assertion-based PASS. Interpretation does not become source fact by repetition.
operator_semantics.NEXT_STEP_EVIDENCE_CLOSURE_VALID: Every material source/evidence dependency required to execute current_in_progress_step or next_recommended_step must be either explicitly present/validated in the transferred source/evidence state or represented as a blocking required_input with exact identity and post-receipt validation rule. The card must not claim continuation sufficiency while silently depending on an uncarried, unrequested material source.

failure_mode_state_template.restoration_rule: Restore exact failure-mode records as UNVALIDATED_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT. surfaced_object_ledger_state_template.restoration_rule: Treat all snapshots as historical provenance only. Validate ledger chain, hashes, source-message ordering, object identities, and capture cutoff. No historical object becomes current execution authority; current HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment and Artifact rebinding remain required.

semantic_alignment_contract.proportionality_rule: Formalize only elements whose loss or reinterpretation could materially affect correctness, scope, authority, execution, evidence, acceptance, safety, or receiver-facing claims.
semantic_alignment_contract.equivalence_rule: Equivalent wording or harmless representational differences are not semantic drift when operative material meaning, constraints, context, requested effect, and authority are preserved.
semantic_alignment_contract.pass_rule: PASS only when no detected material semantic transformation changes the operative meaning required for the affected task/action/output and no material ambiguity remains unresolved for that boundary.
semantic_alignment_contract.review_reject_routing: Use existing Core uncertainty, correction, governance, amendment, or recovery routes; this contract creates no parallel authority.
semantic_alignment_contract.observable_contract_boundary: Surfaced/raw input + identified validated context/source evidence -> canonical intent -> task/Artifact -> plan/action -> output.

rules: The catalog does not restore, select, approve, compile, bind, or substitute a Specialist by itself.
Exact originating-catalog identity may be established only from recorded designation, version, hash, and foundation compatibility identity.

If the originating index was available and its exact bytes were carried or referenced, file_identity_and_delivery_state.file_receipts should preserve its canonical filename, designation, version, hash, bytes, and delivery state.
A missing current index degrades only catalog discovery; it does not invalidate otherwise valid explicit Specialist/package handoff state.
A different current index preserves restored Specialist/package state and requires targeted catalog compatibility reconciliation before new discovery.
A foundation-incompatible current index is treated as a new-environment discovery input and cannot be represented as exact continuation.
For supported legacy cards with no originating catalog provenance, record LEGACY_UNRECORDED rather than inferring an originating catalog from the currently supplied index.
Migration to schema 2.3.0 does not grant the Specialist Package Index route, selection, approval, compilation, binding, or execution authority.

transfer_ownership_contract.purpose: Define one canonical transfer carrier for current transfer-level state while preserving source-object snapshots as non-executable provenance.
rules: AIR_HANDOFF_CARD is a transfer record and may serialize source-object snapshots; snapshots never become current execution authority on restore.

When the same conceptual datum appears in a source-object snapshot and a transfer-level carrier, the source snapshot preserves provenance while the transfer-level carrier named below governs transfer interpretation.
A repeated value without a distinct source-snapshot role or explicit reference is invalid redundant transfer state.

Historical alignment evaluations, action authorizations, gates, receipts, and artifact bindings restore only as provenance/history unless the current runtime separately revalidates and reissues the required current object.
Action-history snapshots must preserve only observed source-session canonical object identities; missing authorizations remain missing or unknown and are never reconstructed during handoff creation.

Failure-mode records restore only from the serialized failure_mode_state carrier and preserve source IDs, evidence, applicability, corrective constraints, retest state, recurrence, and supersession without semantic broadening.

The surfaced_object_ledger_state is the canonical immutable transfer carrier for all formal AIR objects actually emitted before the Handoff file freeze point; snapshots preserve exact structure/values and never restore execution authority.
Durable provenance snapshots remain historical source snapshots only; store presence or carried Handoff snapshots grant no current authority.

Decision Trace projections in decision_trace_state transfer only surfaced evidence/rule-linked justification state; they never transfer hidden reasoning or create approval, binding, authorization, or execution authority.

A transferred CURRENT Decision Trace is continuation evidence only and becomes STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_REVALIDATION until exact current basis revalidation; historical traces remain immutable nonoperative provenance.

Law-source package pin and provider provenance transfer only through source_state.law_source_transfer_state, remain nonauthorizing, and require current-session package/provider identity revalidation where declared.

Execution-granularity preference transfers only through the five working_agreement Rev26 fields, remains workflow preference only, and never grants scope, Gate, approval, Authorization or execution authority.

source_snapshot_roles.AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.active_artifact: IMMUTABLE_PROVENANCE_SNAPSHOT_OF_SOURCE_ARTIFACT; prior binding/action/delivery values cannot override transfer-level carriers or restore execution authority.
source_snapshot_roles.AIR_HANDOFF_CARD.active_contract: IMMUTABLE_PROVENANCE_SNAPSHOT_OF_CONTRACT_INPUT; cannot override the Artifact or create execution authority.

transfer_ownership_contract.restore_rule: Resolve transfer-level carriers first, preserve source snapshots as provenance, then execute current-session validation/alignment and artifact rebinding. Never select a newer duplicate by convenience.

runtime_drift_hardening_schema_extension.restore_boundary: Historical alignment evaluation/snapshots, action authorizations, checkpoints and dependency records restore as non-authorizing provenance/state only. Pre-rev24 broad-drift snapshots remain immutable. Current model drift, reconciliation state, dependency closure, validation, and Artifact binding are recomputed/revalidated in the receiving session before execution.

checkpoint_lineage_state.restoration_rule: Restore exact checkpoint records as non-authorizing continuation state; verify parent lineage, controlling Artifact, fingerprints, approvals/packages, constraints, completed receipts, blockers/dependencies, next transition, invalidators and evidence before resumable use. Inaccessible conversation prose may not supply missing current authority.

durable_dependency_state.restoration_rule: Restore exact AIR_DEPENDENCY_RECORD state as non-authorizing continuation input; revalidate required/observed identities, satisfaction, blocking state, evidence, invalidators, resume condition and lifecycle in the current session before affected continuation.

runtime_alignment_state.restoration_rule: Historical alignment evaluation is provenance only and must not be restored as current authority. Execute HANDOFF_RESTORE evaluation in the new session before state-sensitive construction, material action, or governed continuation.

semantic_fidelity_state.restoration_rule: Restore explicit typed canonical-intent state, intent-execution alignment state, source-intent invariants, material-claim provenance, current-state coherence, claim/source consistency, next-step evidence-closure, and fidelity audit state only as non-authorizing continuation input. Raw input and identified authoritative source evidence remain authoritative for fidelity checks. Re-run current-session source-to-handoff-to-restored reconciliation, semantic-delta classification, omission/invention/contradiction checks, current-state coherence, next-step evidence closure, and intent-to-task-to-plan/action-to-output reconciliation before affected approval, execution, or delivery. Do not silently infer, repair, narrow, broaden, substitute, or resolve missing intent.

canonical_intent_state.restoration_rule: Restore only explicit supported material intent elements and source references. Missing elements remain unrecorded/unresolved; do not reconstruct them from narrative proximity or model preference.

intent_execution_alignment_state.restoration_rule: Restore only explicit non-authorizing alignment evidence. PASS/REVIEW/REJECT from a source session is continuation evidence only and must be re-evaluated against current intent, context, Artifact, authority constraints, and proposed action before affected execution or delivery.

decision_trace_state.restoration_rule: Restore Decision Trace state only as non-authorizing continuation evidence. Never synthesize historical traces. Any transferred CURRENT trace becomes STALE_PENDING_CURRENT_SESSION_REVALIDATION until exact current evidence identities/hashes/states, rule refs and law-resolution fingerprint, controlling Artifact revision/lease, authority-state refs, uncertainty state, claim/source consistency, and forced-walk basis are revalidated. Historical or superseded traces remain immutable NONOPERATIVE_HISTORY and never restore approval or execution authority. If the immediate next material step depends on a trace, carry the exact current trace projection/fingerprint or an explicit blocking required-input identity.

mii_state.restoration_rule: MII state is continuation input only. Cognitive contributions have no positive execution authority and become operative only after validation and compilation into or explicit reference by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT benchmark.

morphology_state.restoration_rule: Re-evaluate task and node morphology against current task intent, MII route objectives, benchmark, risk/evidence pressure, and Core RT.MORPHOLOGY_BIND. Prior Q4/Q4D state is a continuity/delivery prior only.

epistemic_sufficiency_state.restoration_rule: Material uncertainty remains unresolved until Core RT.UNCERTAINTY_RESOLVE obtains or validates the smallest sufficient input. Do not silently infer missing basis from handoff proximity or prior momentum.

failure_mode_state.restoration_rule: Restore exact failure-mode records as UNVALIDATED_BOOTSTRAP_INPUT. Revalidate evidence, lifecycle, applicability signatures, supersession, recurrence, and current task match; compile applicable constraints into the rebound Orbit 0 Artifact before they become operative. Specialist packages consume only Core-validated applicable records.

surfaced_object_ledger_state.restoration_rule: Treat all snapshots as historical provenance only. Validate ledger chain, hashes, source-message ordering, object identities, capture cutoff, and durable-capture metadata when native rev19 history is claimed. No historical object becomes current execution authority; current HANDOFF_RESTORE alignment and Artifact rebinding remain required.
